uncertainties.detail: Source states '8 years of experience'; treated as approximate, not computed from employment dates.
Degree line combines 'Bachelor of Engineering in ECE' with institution and year; field_of_study split out as ECE.
Source is listed under Certifications; CSPO is presented as a certification but issuing body not verified.
Key Projects listed under National Payments Corporation of India were not explicitly tied to individual dates or roles; recorded as projects with no association field in schema.
Local categories put NPCI project and responsibility blocks under 'projects' rather than 'experience'; re-associated to experience/3 based on source order.
